role: Single quality gate for optical (Verity Sense) PPI intervals used by both the live stream and offline downloads: blocker bit, error estimate <= 20 ms, and 300–2000 ms range; plus offline PPI → RRPoint conversion.

units.does: Returns ppInMs when blockerBit == 0, ppErrorEstimate <= 20 and ppInMs within the accepted range; else nil.
units.entry: Called from PolarManager.ingestPpi (PolarManager+Streaming.swift:129) and rrPoints; tests StrapPPIFilterTests.

branches.cond: blocker bit clear and error <= 20 ms

units.does: Converts offline PPI samples to RRPoints, keeping only accepted intervals. t_ms accumulates only accepted beats; wallClockMs is the real time since the recording began, accumulated over every sample's interval (accepted or not, negatives as 0), so consumers reading wallClockMs ?? t_ms (window selection, sleep boundaries, the recording-break check, StrapRecording.endedAt) keep real time across rejected stretches.

branches.effect: processed in order; the deferred step adds the sample's interval to the wall clock whether or not it is kept
true: skipped, no beat time added (wall clock still advances); false: appended at the beat time with the wall clock
